title: Friends with Benefits
summary: Friends with benefits (FWB) means friends who have sex without being in a romantic relationship. It works best when both are honest about expectations and feelings.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
